Onix Plugin Documentation

Changelog 3

Previous Changelog

Introduction

This changelog documents what changed in the third update of the Plugins API.
Since this is very early-access and the API is still being developed, there will a lot of changes and breaking changes.
There will be a clear changelog for each update, so you can easily see what changed and what you need to do to adapt your plugin.
This update is pretty much the whole package, you need to update the client first, that should take care of the new runtime.

.plugin install uuid 50b8338a-1cc4-44ca-81ef-5ecf1062c37c

That will install the latest version of the Plugin Manager UI.

Breaking Changes

Rendering Changes

  • RendererWorld.EnableLights has been removed.
    • You should now use IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameters with a material that has the Light property set to true.
    • You can also toggle just that with IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameter using Light and true.
  • RendererWorld.PushWorldRenderSettings has been removed.
    • You should now use IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameters with a Material containing the settings you're looking for.
    • You can also toggle a specific setting with IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameter specifying which parameter to change.
    • UI simulation mode can be changed using RendererWorld.IsSimulatingUi but as before, you shouldn't touch that yourself.

Settings Changes

  • The gfx in OnixSettingRenderer's Render function will have its Width/Height/Size match the size parameter.

Block Changes

  • Block.States has been renamed to Block.RawStates.
    • You should likely avoid using that in 99.99% of cases as the information isn't necessarily accurate on all versions.
    • I would trust nothing but the Name and the StateId.
  • Block.GetState has been renamed to Block.GetStateValue.
    • It has the same behavior as before, you give it a name or id and it returns the value for that state.

Runtime Changes

Material System

  • Materials have been introduced.
    • This lets you set specific parameters for rendering, such as light, inputs like gradient or uv, if textures are linear, culling modes.
    • Those are fine-tuned materials that should respect most of the combinations of parameters.
    • Some parameters kill or break some behavior, but if you wish to suggest a fix by all means send us the material's JSON.
    • You can set individual parameters using IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameter or set a whole material using IGameRenderer.SetMaterialParameters.
    • There are getter functions for the parameters, such as IGameRenderer.GetMaterialParameter and IGameRenderer.GetMaterialParameters.
    • Note that the individual parameter setter returns the previous value, so you can restore it if you're doing a one off.
    • You can also set any material from the game or a pack using IGameRenderer.SetMaterialCustom specifying its name and if it is in the common.json or fancy/sad.json.
    • RendererCommon.SetDefaultState will bind the default material as well as all default settings if you ever need it.
    • The material system is available in IGameRenderer so you get the advantages of materials for UI too.
      • Note that for UI, some parameters are not supported like light, and some should always be enabled.
      • You can use IGameRenderer.GetMaterialParameters to see the default parameters.

New Features

  • BlockGraphics has been added, giving you information like block shape and texture.
    • You can access it using the Block.Graphics property.
  • Added With methods for most math types.
    • Vec3.WithX - Vec3.WithY - Vec3.WithZ
    • Vec2.WithX - Vec2.WithY
    • BlockPos.WithX - BlockPos.WithY - BlockPos.WithZ
    • Vec2i.WithX - Vec2i.WithY
    • Rect.WithX - Rect.WithY - Rect.WithZ - Rect.WithW
    • Rect.WithWidth - Rect.WithHeight - Rect.WithSize
  • MightOwnMemoryAddressContainer and MemoryAddressContainer now have an operator== and a GetHashCode().
  • ItemStack now has an HasEnchantOverlay property.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed WorldChunk's LoadState property always being Unloaded.
  • Fixed Onix.Game.InvokeUri forcing you to be in a world and throwing an exception.
  • Fixed Dimension's Id property always being Overworld.
  • Fixed WorldChunk.GetBlock always returning null.
  • Fixed WorldChunk.GetRainHeightAt always returning 0.
  • Fixed WorldChunk.GetHeightAt always returning 0.
  • Fixed BlockRegistry.GetBlock never finding blocks on 1.12.
  • Fixed InsufficientTrustException not being thrown/reported and silently failing.
  • Fixed SettingChangedDelegate getting garbage collected and crashing the dotnet runtime when invoked.
  • Fixed MemoryHelpers.ScanSignature now returns the correct address of the signature it finds.

Client Changes

Version Updates

  • Now expects runtime version 3.

Bug Fixes

  • Notifications happening in weird orders should no longer freeze the game.
  • Input events are no longer duplicated.
  • Fixed changing skins from the client on 1.21.20 to 1.21.60.
